keywords: Partition – Identification of corpus – Preliminary survey – Defendants claiming Lots 1 and 4 excluded from corpus – Earlier partition and res judicata asserted – Plaintiff admitting portions on eastern side wrongly included – Alternative plan – Plaintiff cannot seek partition of land not co-owned by her – Duty of trial judge to satisfy himself regarding identity of land – Incorrect extent/boundaries – Proper identification of corpus essential to partition decree.
legistation: Partition law principles governing identification of corpus, investigation of title and res judicata; Prescription Ordinance principles were also raised by defendants.
